name: _document.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  structure/_document.scss — document base — html/body resets, the body-glow-drift backdrop keyframes, #app mount, element resets, app-root, modal scroll-lock.
//  Imported by _structure.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Page base styles (html then html.dark-mode overrides above).
html {
  color-scheme: light;
  background-color: var(--bg-primary);
  min-height: 100%;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: scroll; // always show scrollbar to prevent layout shift on navigation
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;

  // Native browser scrollbar theme — inherits from color-scheme
  scrollbar-color: var(--border-color) transparent;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}

// Scroll-lock applied while a modal is open (JS toggles this class).
html.modal-open {
  overflow-y: hidden; // hide background scrollbar when any modal is open
}

// Document body base: bg-primary fill, text-primary ink, primary font.
body {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 100vh;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  // An unbreakable title word (long compound locales) must never push the
  // page wider than the viewport — clip it at the body edge so no
  // horizontal scrollbar appears and full-bleed backgrounds stay aligned.
  overflow-x: hidden;
  background-color: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  transition:
    background-color 0.3s ease,
    color 0.3s ease;

  // Never break words mid-character anywhere in the site.
  // Words always wrap whole to the next line.
  word-break: normal;
  overflow-wrap: normal; // never split a word across lines — wrap entire words only
  hyphens: none; // no automatic hyphenation

  // The animated degradê backdrop: a fixed, oversized wash layer behind all
  // content (z-index -1 keeps it above the body's own background but below
  // every child). Transform-only animation → pure compositor, no repaints.
  // The -25% inset oversizes the layer so the drift never exposes an edge.
  &::before {
    content: '';
    position: fixed;
    inset: -25%;
    z-index: -1;
    background: var(--bg-glow);
    animation: body-glow-drift 46s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
}

// Slow drift path — three poses on alternate so the loop reads as an
// endless wander rather than a ping-pong between two corners.
@keyframes body-glow-drift {
  0% {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1);
  }

  50% {
    transform: translate3d(2.5%, -2%, 0) scale(1.06);
  }

  100% {
    transform: translate3d(-2%, 2.5%, 0) scale(1.03);
  }
}

// App mount point — fills the viewport.
#app {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  background: transparent;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

q,
h1,
h2,
h3,
h4,
h5,
h6,
p,
span,
a,
label,
ul,
ol,
figure,
video,
image,
iframe,
picture,
blockquote {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

ul,
ol {
  list-style: none;
}

a {
  font-size: 100%;
  vertical-align: baseline;
  background: transparent;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
}

button {
  @extend %RESETBTN;
}

app-root,
view-home,
view-project,
view-legal,
view-not-found,
view-admin-login,
view-cms-dashboard,
app-nav,
home-mosaic,
about-section,
contact-section,
awards-mentions,
awards-carousel,
custom-carousel,
preferences-modal,
lang-dialog,
cookie-banner,
portfolio-related,
media-figure,
media-expanded {
  display: block;
}

draw-text {
  display: inline;
}

// Routed content host (#main).
main {
  // Clearance for the fixed cookie banner — without it the banner covers
  // the page bottom (legal footer unreachable) until consent is answered.
  padding-bottom: var(--cookie-banner-h);

  .modal-open & {
    position: fixed;
    top: var(
      --modal-top,
      0px
    ); // Set via JS before class toggle — prevents iOS Safari scroll-to-top
    width: 100%;
    left: 0;
  }
}

#main {
  min-height: 100vh;
}

// Section markers the nav's scroll tracker measures (#about/#contact offsets).
#home,
#about,
#contact {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
}

// Home section top anchor.
#home {
  @include layout-1024() {
    min-height: 100vh;
  }
}
